doc.description: Provide threads and synchronization primitives. ABI messages must be sent from the main thread (the one running the periodic and event functions): their receivers are not thread-safe. With ABI_CHECK_MAIN_THREAD every ABI message checks it, and one sent from another thread stops the program at that call (abort in NPS/SITL, halt on ChibiOS).

define.name: ABI_CHECK_MAIN_THREAD
define.description: Stop the program when an ABI message is sent outside the main thread (default TRUE in NPS/SITL, FALSE otherwise)
